correctness.rationale: The lower bound is Proposition 4.3 applied to \([\emptyset,A]_L=\mathcal{P}(A)\). For the upper bound, the source restriction map is isometric on the target interval. On \(U\), finite meet preservation forces \(x^*(B\setminus A)=x^*(\emptyset)\), and finite join preservation then gives \(x^*(B)=x^*(B\cap A)\). Hence all restricted generators are indexed by \(\mathcal{P}(A)\), and rational finite lattice-linear expressions give the required density bound. The degenerate case \(A=\emptyset\) is explicitly excluded.
